protocol.normalization: all origin-known development-start observations, mean count with floor 1
protocol.peer_policy: all origin-known valid observations, target excluded, equal mass per player; never future memberships
protocol.population: all players with one prior observation; no current roster/membership/positive points/adjacency filter; targets conditional on observed rows
protocol.primary_holdout: late 2025 season previously unscored in original benchmark; freeze before opening
protocol.recency_and_shrinkage: all available earlier seasons/observations; existing empirical count architecture
protocol.replication: 2026 period previously examined by 24-player benchmark, explicitly not untouched
protocol.season_to_date: own and peer history restricted to target current season for equal-weight baseline
protocol.segments: origin-known mean observed minutes: low <15, medium 15..<28, high >=28; unknown retained separately
protocol.selection: lowest equally weighted normalized eleven-count development MAE among season-to-date, recency grid and shrinkage grid; tie by model then shorter half-life
protocol.update_policy: daily inference fits newly known count summaries; configuration/calibration frozen; no automatic model promotion or retraining policy enabled
